title: Employee Performance and Mental Well-Being: The Mitigating Effects of Transformational Leadership During Crisis
eligible_reason: DiD comparing employees of transformational vs. transactional managers (a time-invariant exposure measure) before vs. during the Covid-19 crisis (Apr 2020-Jan 2021). The crisis is one common shock date for all units, so there is no staggered adoption of a binary treatment.
design_notes: Outcomes observed before and during the crisis use Crisis_t x leadership style (Crisis = Apr20-Jan21; Crisis High = Apr20-Aug20, Crisis Low = Sep20-Jan21). A month fixed-effect variant absorbs the Crisis indicator (Table B.13); a controls and clustered-SE variant is Table B.10. Mental well-being outcomes observed only during the crisis use simple differences with week fixed effects. Treatment intensity is continuous (leadership measure), not binary.
screener_notes: Ineligible: single common shock date, time-invariant treated group. Employer personnel data likely proprietary.
